get.description: Returns all permissions. Requires permissions:read permission.

delete.description: Delete a permission. Requires permissions:delete permission.

get.description: Returns a paginated list of users. Requires users:read permission.

post.description: Create a new user. Requires users:create permission.

get.description: Returns a single user. Requires users:read permission.

put.description: Update user fields. Requires users:update permission.

delete.description: Soft-deletes a user by setting deleted_at. Requires users:delete permission.
